acceptance_criteria.criterion: POST /api/calculate/class-range accepts a ClassRangeRequest JSON body and returns a valid ClassRangeResponse
Response includes min/max/median RangeMetric objects for: massRatio, dragChange, inertiaChange, jerkChange, and (when engine selected) topSpeed and acceleration
Response identifies worst-case ship (highest mass ratio) and best-case ship (lowest mass ratio) with their metrics
Ships with getCargoCapacity() == 0 are handled without division-by-zero errors
Engine-dependent metrics (topSpeed, acceleration) are null/omitted when no engineId is provided
Backend endpoint responds in <100ms for the full ship class iteration
All new DTOs have readonly properties and declare(strict_types=1)
